notes.title: New game in the Bundle!
notes.notes:
Hi everybody, 

As you know, support for the Adobe Flash program was terminated this year. This may have caused errors in one of the games from 6-in-1 Bundle. We want to be honest with our players, so we added one more fun game to the bundle – Elementary My Dear Majesty!  

Tower of Souls will also remain in the bundle, as not all players face the above problem. Hope you’ll enjoy! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/448400/Hidden_Object_6in1_bundle/

Yours faithfully, 
Alawar.
